jobs.title: Automation Engineer I/II - Discovery Oncology
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Summary

We're looking for an Automation Engineer I/II to help build, operate, and maintain the automated systems that power our laboratory workflows. You'll work alongside a senior Lab Automation Engineer, Automation Scientist, and bench scientists to keep systems running reliably and to support the rollout of new automated workflows — with the senior Lab Automation Engineer serving as your primary technical mentor as you grow into a more senior automation role. This role reports to the AVP-Automation, Discovery Oncology and will be on-site in NYC.

Responsibilities

Operate and maintain lab automation equipment (liquid handlers, plate readers, robotic workcells, etc) to support daily experimental throughput

Assist in troubleshooting instrument and integration-level errors; escalate complex root-cause issues to the team

Support installation, calibration, and preventive maintenance of automated workcells and liquid handlers

Write and modify basic automation scripts/protocols (e.g., in Python, C#, Fluent Control, or Cellario) under guidance

Document SOPs, error logs, and maintenance records to support reproducibility and audit-readiness

Partner with lab scientists and automation scientists to understand workflow requirements and translate them into automation-friendly steps

Monitor system performance and flag opportunities for reliability or throughput improvements

Provide day-to-day technical support to bench scientists using automated systems

Take on increasing ownership of small technical projects under the Sr Advisor Lab Automation Engineer's mentorship, as a growth path toward more senior automation engineering work

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Physics, or related technical field (or equivalent experience)

1–2 years of experience with laboratory automation, robotics, or a related hands-on technical role (internships count)

Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Vaccine Company will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with liquid handling platforms (e.g., Hamilton, Agilent, Tecan, Beckman Coulter/Labcyte)

Basic scripting ability (Python, VBA, C# or similar)

Strong attention to detail and good documentation habits

Comfortable working hands-on in a wet lab environment; some roles require standing/lifting up to 25 lbs

Good communicator, eager to learn from senior team members

Experience using AI to write code or create simple UIs

Experience executing scientific experiments in the lab

Familiarity with lab scheduling software (Cellario, Momentum, GBG, etc)

Coursework or experience with CAD (SolidWorks, Inventor)

Familiarity with PLCs, safety circuits, or basic controls

Additional Information

The appointed candidate will work on-site, full-time, in New York, NY

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer with a background in generative modeling to help develop next-generation AI models for understanding human behavior. Based in New York City, this full-time, on-site position offers the opportunity to turn early technical ideas into robust AI systems and build a core technology platform from the ground up.

Develop generative models that improve how machine learning models are trained and evaluated using real-world sensing data.

Design, build, and validate simulation and generative modeling pipelines for real-world time-series data.
Rapidly iterate on technical approaches based on experimental results and product needs.
Collaborate with hardware, sensing, and machine learning teams to integrate developed solutions into training and evaluation pipelines.

Strong foundation in deep learning, including experience with generative models and/or Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs).
Comfort working with real-world time-series data, noisy signals, ambiguous requirements, and fast iteration cycles.
Experience with PyTorch or similar machine learning frameworks.
Ability to move quickly from prototypes to working systems while maintaining engineering rigor.
Ownership mindset, practical problem-solving skills, and comfort working in an early-stage startup.
MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Machine Learning, or a related field. Exceptional undergraduate candidates with strong relevant experience will also be considered.

Experience with multiphysics simulation tools such as COMSOL is strongly preferred.
Publications in NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or related venues are a plus but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary of $160,000–$200,000, plus equity.
Direct collaboration with the founding team.
Top-tier VC backing.
Opportunity to help build a technology company from the ground up at the intersection of AI, wearables, and real-world human behavior understanding.

Work Arrangement & Location

Full-time, on-site position in New York City.

Send your resume to career@behaviorai.ai or apply directly through LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Data Curation - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer for our Autonomous Vehicles Data Curation team. The role involves applying state-of-the-art techniques to search, curate, and evaluate high-quality datasets and ground truth for autonomous vehicles, a critical aspect of our next-generation products. You will have the opportunity to work with top researchers and engineers in the field of deep learning and computer vision to deliver impact to our customers around the world. Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. The era of AI has begun. NVIDIA's GPUs run Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and act as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and AI come together in our architecture.

NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI company”. Make your choice to join us today. We are training Deep Neural Networks and developing data search and curation capabilities for NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicles effort, with the goal to enable autonomous driving. We are seeking Deep Learning/Machine Learning engineers who are passionate about building the datasets and tools that support perception, prediction, planning and control for self-driving cars to achieve full autonomy. Are you interested in applying AI to discover and understand challenging driving scenarios at scale? If so, join us!

What You'll Be Doing

Stay up to date with the latest research and innovations in deep learning, implement and experiment with new ideas.
Foster collaborative partnerships with our researchers and engineers, transforming innovative research into robust, industrial-strength machine learning models.
Taking approaches from initial evaluation and experimentation all the way to shipping.
Defining, collecting, and curating training and evaluation datasets, with a focus on scenario coverage and label quality.
Developing vision-language models and embeddings for scenario search, classification, and automated data curation.
Building training pipelines and scalable inference systems (PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorRT, Python, C++).

What We Need To See

PhD with 1+ year, or MS (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years, of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proven experience building robust software.
Passionate about Artificial Intelligence for robotics and autonomous navigation
Strive to learn new things and like solving hard problems
Math knowledge
Experience in Deep Learning / Machine Learning. You have a background in Computer Vision and/or multimodal learning.
Programming and debugging skills in C++ and/or Python.
Good communication and analytical skills. Ability to work with multiple teams in a dynamic environment.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Background in applying latest AI methods to solve Computer Vision and Autonomous Vehicles problems
Experience with Unsupervised or Self-supervised Learning and contrastive representation learning.
Experience with vision-language models, agentic search, or automated dataset quality evaluation.

We believe that realizing self-driving cars will be a defining contribution of our generation. We have the funding and scale, but we need your help. NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

#AutonomousVehicles

152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

new_jobs.description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer for our Autonomous Vehicles Data Curation team. The role involves applying state-of-the-art techniques to search, curate, and evaluate high-quality datasets and ground truth for autonomous vehicles, a critical aspect of our next-generation products. You will have the opportunity to work with top researchers and engineers in the field of deep learning and computer vision to deliver impact to our customers around the world. Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. The era of AI has begun. NVIDIA's GPUs run Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and act as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and AI come together in our architecture.

NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI company”. Make your choice to join us today. We are training Deep Neural Networks and developing data search and curation capabilities for NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicles effort, with the goal to enable autonomous driving. We are seeking Deep Learning/Machine Learning engineers who are passionate about building the datasets and tools that support perception, prediction, planning and control for self-driving cars to achieve full autonomy. Are you interested in applying AI to discover and understand challenging driving scenarios at scale? If so, join us!

What You'll Be Doing

Stay up to date with the latest research and innovations in deep learning, implement and experiment with new ideas.
Foster collaborative partnerships with our researchers and engineers, transforming innovative research into robust, industrial-strength machine learning models.
Taking approaches from initial evaluation and experimentation all the way to shipping.
Defining, collecting, and curating training and evaluation datasets, with a focus on scenario coverage and label quality.
Developing vision-language models and embeddings for scenario search, classification, and automated data curation.
Building training pipelines and scalable inference systems (PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorRT, Python, C++).

What We Need To See

PhD with 1+ year, or MS (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years, of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proven experience building robust software.
Passionate about Artificial Intelligence for robotics and autonomous navigation
Strive to learn new things and like solving hard problems
Math knowledge
Experience in Deep Learning / Machine Learning. You have a background in Computer Vision and/or multimodal learning.
Programming and debugging skills in C++ and/or Python.
Good communication and analytical skills. Ability to work with multiple teams in a dynamic environment.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Background in applying latest AI methods to solve Computer Vision and Autonomous Vehicles problems
Experience with Unsupervised or Self-supervised Learning and contrastive representation learning.
Experience with vision-language models, agentic search, or automated dataset quality evaluation.

We believe that realizing self-driving cars will be a defining contribution of our generation. We have the funding and scale, but we need your help. NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
